reflections.task: diagnose Supertonic 3 model load SIGABRT on iOS
reflections.summary: The model load aborted when its ai.onnx.ml opset exceeded the ONNX Runtime version bundled by the platform package.
reflections.lesson: For an uncaught Ort::Exception during model construction, compare every model opset import with the platform-specific bundled runtime before changing application code.
reflections.trigger_condition: A native sherpa-onnx package aborts while loading an ONNX model and the fatal message names an unsupported opset domain.
reflections.repair_action: Inspect the platform build script and native model-construction boundary, verify the bundled runtime version, and test the model with a compatible runtime.
reflections.anti_pattern: Assuming all platform packages bundle the same ONNX Runtime or copying one platform's supported opset limit.
reflections.verification_method: Confirm the platform runtime version, model opset imports, constructor stack, and successful load under a compatible runtime.
negative_preconditions: Do not assume the iOS runtime version applies to HarmonyOS.
Do not treat a model metadata mismatch as proof that the ArkTS wrapper caused it.

reflections.task: trace a cross-platform native model-load abort
reflections.summary: Separate model/runtime compatibility from exception-boundary behavior, then trace the language wrapper through NAPI and the C API constructor.
reflections.lesson: A model-load abort needs two checks: the platform-specific runtime must support the model metadata, and native exceptions must not escape the language boundary uncaught.
reflections.trigger_condition: An ArkTS or other language wrapper terminates during native ONNX model construction with an Ort::Exception or unsupported-opset message.
reflections.repair_action: Follow the wrapper-to-native constructor path, inspect the platform runtime build version, compare model domain imports, and verify exception conversion separately from compatibility.
reflections.anti_pattern: Stopping at the first wrapper stack frame or reusing another platform's runtime version as current evidence.
reflections.verification_method: Verify the exact platform package revision, build script, native constructor, exception boundary, and model load with compatible metadata/runtime.
negative_preconditions: Static call paths do not prove the failing branch executed without the real log.
A newer runtime may change deployment requirements and must be validated independently.
